result.rationale: The model's before_validation callback calls `self.host.sub!(/^https?:\/\//, '')` on the host attribute (embeddable_host.rb). If the client submits a blank/missing host (controller sets `host.host = params[:embeddable_host][:host]`, which can be nil), `nil.sub!` raises NoMethodError before validations run, producing a 500 instead of the intended validation error via `render_json_error(host)`. The format validation would only run after the callback, so the crash path is real per the diff.

adjudication.rationale: In `EmbeddableHost` the `before_validation` callback unconditionally calls `self.host.sub!(...)` twice. If `host` is `nil`, this will raise `NoMethodError` before validations run. In `Admin::EmbeddableHostsController#save_host`, `host.host` is assigned from `params[:embeddable_host][:host]` with no guard, so a missing/blank `host` param can result in `host.host = nil` and trigger the `nil.sub!` crash.
